title: KSEBL Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for General Manager Posts
description: Kerala State Electricity Board Limited (KSEBL) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various General Manager jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech in Civil Engineering can  grab this chance and apply for the KSEBL Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
